rows.quote: Then we obtained the genetic associations with IHD, using a GWAS meta-analysis from Coronary ARtery DIsease Genome wide Replication and Meta-analysis (CARDIoGRAM) plus The Coronary Artery Disease (C4D) Genetics (CARDIoGRAMplusC4D) including UK Biobank SOFT CAD GWAS (10,801cases and 137,371 controls), CARDIoGRAMplusC4D 1000 Genomes-based GWAS (60,801 CAD cases and 123,504 controls) and the Myocardial Infarction Genetics and CARDIoGRAM Exome (42,335 cases and 78,240 controls)24.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names a CARDIoGRAMplusC4D meta-analysis of three component GWAS with citation 24; the entry DOI is the source of no dictionary row, and the 1000 Genomes GWAS is only one component.
FinnGen named with case and control counts only; no release number stated.
UKB-PPP named with a citation shared by several rows and a participant count that equals no UKB-PPP row size.

rows.quote: For replication, we used another GWAS in deCODE23, a GWAS of 4907 proteins in 35,559 Icelanders, to examine the role of statins on selected protein(s).
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat. Genet. 2021 53 1712 1721 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the replication GWAS of 4907 proteins in 35,559 Icelanders to deCODE with citation 23; the entry DOI is the Ferkingstad 2021 row source only.
